mapper.select: -- 根据主体映射获取所有角色编码 SELECT DISTINCT gt.role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = gt.role_code WHERE r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0

, all_role_codes AS ( -- 根据主体映射获取所有角色编码 SELECT DISTINCT gt.role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = gt.role_code WHERE r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0) -- 最终关联权限表（不区分 permission_type，含按钮与 API） SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN all_role_codes arc ON rp.role_code = arc.role_code JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code = rp.permission_code WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0

SELECT ds.policy_holder_type, ds.scope_resource_code, ds.scope_dimension_type, ds.scope_type, ds.scope_subject_ids FROM data_scope_grant_table ds JOIN all_subjects s ON ds.policy_holder_type = s.sub_type AND ds.policy_holder_id = s.sub_id WHERE ds.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ds.scope_resource_code, CASE ds.policy_holder_type WHEN 'USER' THEN 1 WHEN 'ROLE' THEN 2 # WHEN 'DEPT' THEN 3 # WHEN 'POST' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END
